old_caption: The video captures an aerial view of the iconic Sutro Tower in San Francisco, standing tall amidst a sea of clouds. The tower, a prominent structure with multiple antennas at its peak, is surrounded by a thick blanket of fog that envelops the city below. As the camera moves forward and slightly downward, it reveals the dense fog covering the urban landscape, with only glimpses of buildings and trees peeking through. The sky above is a clear, vibrant blue, providing a striking contrast to the white, fluffy clouds below. The camera movement is smooth and steady, offering a comprehensive view of the tower's surroundings and the atmospheric conditions.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures an aerial view of the iconic Sutro Tower in San Francisco, standing tall amidst a sea of clouds. The tower, a prominent structure with multiple antennas at its peak, is surrounded by a thick blanket of fog that envelops the city below. As the camera pans around the tower, it reveals the dense fog covering the urban landscape, with only glimpses of buildings and trees peeking through. The sky above is a clear, vibrant blue, providing a striking contrast to the white, fluffy clouds below. The camera movement is smooth and steady, offering a comprehensive view of the tower's surroundings and the atmospheric conditions. The scene remains consistent throughout the video, emphasizing the serene and ethereal beauty of the fog-covered cityscape.
caption: The video captures an aerial view of a tall red-and-white lattice tower with antenna masts, rising above a dense sea of low clouds under clear blue sky. Sunlight glows brightly from the right, washing the cloud tops with pale gold and leaving the tower sharply outlined against the sky. The tower remains fixed in structure while the camera slowly drifts, shifting it slightly leftward within the frame. Clouds churn and reshape continuously around the lower legs, altering how much of the base is visible as the view advances. A dark ridge and a few small buildings emerge through the mist at the bottom left, becoming clearer as the fog shifts. The sky stays open and bright, with no object entering or leaving the scene.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
